verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring evaluation runs or workflows is a fair question for an AI evaluation and observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents only one-off experiment runs (via the UI or MCP) and threshold alerts evaluated over a time window. Neither is a user-defined recurring job schedule, and an alert's time window is an adjacent monitoring control, not scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
